[Background(image="77_g7_rooftop",screenadapt="coverall",fadetime=4)]
[delay(time=5)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2387_1#7$2",focus="m")]
[playMusic(intro="$m_sys_act16side_intro",key="$m_sys_act16side_loop", volume=0.6)]
[name="山岸风花"]……啊，异变的景象，消散了！
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4219_yukari_1#6$2",focus="m")]
[name="岳羽由加莉"]所以，我们消灭那个怪物了吗？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2388_1#4$2",focus="m")]
[name="天田乾"]嗯……如果一切如博士所推测，那它的本质应该是不可能完全消灭的……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4218_aigis_1#7$2",focus="m")]
[name="埃癸斯"]但是，我们确实击败了那个怪物，这点我可以确定。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4219_yukari_1#10$2",focus="m")]
[name="岳羽由加莉"]对呀，连那种诡异的景象都消失了嘛……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2387_1#7$2",focus="m")]
[name="山岸风花"]……啊！
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2388_1#9$2",focus="m")]
[name="天田乾"]风花姐，怎么了？！
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2387_1#7$2",focus="m")]
[name="山岸风花"]那种杂音……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2387_1#2$2",focus="m")]
[name="山岸风花"]一直以来干扰着我感知的杂音，也开始减弱了！
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2387_1#4$2",focus="m")]
[name="山岸风花"]我好像能稍微感知到大家的气息了……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2387_1#2$2",focus="m")]
[name="山岸风花"]等杂音再减弱一些，也许……就能感知到门扉的位置了！
